# Wayner Barrios

> Multimodal AI researcher building models that perceive and reason about the world more like we do — from transparent reasoning benchmarks to production-grade inference engines on Apple Silicon.

## Quick facts

- Name: Wayner Barrios
- Role: AI researcher — multimodal reasoning, video understanding, visual grounding, efficient inference
- Education: Ph.D. in Computer Science, Dartmouth College (2026); B.Sc. Universidad del Norte, Colombia
- Based in: Colombia
- Experience: Samsung Research America (reinforcement-learning post-training for multimodal video reasoning)
- Founder: Wiqonn, an AI lab growing ambitious AI work in Latin America
- Languages: English, Spanish
- Status: Open to research scientist and research engineering roles
- ORCID: 0009-0005-1013-5130

## What I'm known for

- **CRYSTAL** (ECCV 2026): benchmark and training framework for transparent multimodal reasoning evaluation — 6,372 instances, every intermediate step checked across 20 models (none maintained more than 60% ordered step accuracy); Causal Process Reward improves step-level consistency by 32% without manual annotations.
- **vLLM-MLX**: OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible LLM/MLLM inference server for Apple Silicon — 400+ tokens per second, 1.5k+ GitHub stars, continuous batching, tool calling, vision, audio, and video support.
- **MoDA** (ICML 2026): instruction-guided channel modulation for fine-grained visual grounding in instructional MLLMs — better grounding across 3 MLLM families and 12 benchmarks with less than 1% additional FLOPs.
- **Native MLX inference at scale**: 525 tokens per second with multimodal prefix caching (28x faster repeated image queries on M4 Max).

## Research areas

- Multimodal AI and reasoning
- Video understanding and visual grounding
- Transparent reasoning evaluation
- Reinforcement-learning post-training
- Efficient LLM and MLLM inference
- Medical AI (multimodal biomarkers, histopathology, weakly-supervised CT)

## Open source

- [vLLM-MLX](https://github.com/waybarrios/vllm-mlx): high-throughput OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible inference for Apple Silicon — continuous batching, tool calling, vision, audio, video; 1.5k+ stars, 400+ tok/s.
- [CRYSTAL](https://github.com/SEE-AI-Lab/crystal): ECCV 2026 benchmark, dataset, and pip-installable metrics for ordered reasoning traces and process-reward training.
- [MoDA](https://github.com/waybarrios/MoDA): official ICML 2026 implementation — instruction-guided channel modulation for visual grounding.
- [Localizing Moments](https://github.com/waybarrios/guidance-based-video-grounding): official ICCV 2023 implementation — describable windows and segment pruning for long-video grounding.
- [DGX Spark Fine-tune LLM](https://github.com/waybarrios/dgx-spark-finetune-llm): LoRA fine-tuning, NVFP4/MXFP8 quantization, TensorRT-LLM export, OpenAI-compatible serving on Blackwell GB10.
- Contributions: GPT4All (77k+ stars), GeoNode (3 merged PRs), MapProxy (dimension-layer caching, 10 commits), Harvard CGA Hypermap Registry (9 merged PRs) and WorldMap (66 commits, 6 PRs), ActivityNet (114 commits), OpenCode Power Pack.
